articles.title_en: Export-Led Industrial Policy for Developing Countries: Is There a Way to Pick Winners?
articles.title_cn: 发展中国家的出口导向型产业政策：有办法挑选赢家吗？
articles.abstract_en: Industrial policy prioritizes growth in specific sectors. Yet there is little agreement about how to target sectors in practice, and many argue that governments cannot pick winners. This essay observes that governments can and do identify tradable sectors where public inputs accelerate growth and generate economic benefits. These strategic sectors are: (1) those that are relatively more productive, and (2) those that are relatively less productive but require technology like the country’s existing technology and have rapidly growing markets and limited international competition. Since developing countries are productive in fewer sectors and have less technology, targeting can be more valuable for them. Export promotion agencies are institutions that have demonstrated effectiveness in coordinating public inputs to grow these sectors. Compared to protectionism, this alternative approach to ‘industrial policy’ is cheaper, less susceptible to capture by unproductive firms, and permissible under the rules of international trade agreements. Many countries’ development strategies adopt this approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 产业政策优先考虑特定部门的增长。然而，关于如何在实际中瞄准部门，几乎没有共识，许多人认为政府无法挑选赢家。本文观察到，政府能够并且确实识别出可贸易部门，在这些部门中，公共投入加速增长并产生经济效益。这些战略部门是：（1）相对更具生产力的部门，以及（2）相对生产力较低但需要与该国现有技术相似的技术，并且市场增长迅速、国际竞争有限的部门。由于发展中国家在较少部门中具有生产力且技术较少，瞄准目标对它们可能更有价值。出口促进机构是已被证明在协调公共投入以发展这些部门方面有效的机构。与保护主义相比，这种‘产业政策’的替代方法更便宜，更不易被无生产力的企业俘获，并且在国际贸易协定规则下是允许的。许多国家的发展战略采用了这种方法。

articles.title_en: The Political Economy of Industrial Policy
articles.title_cn: 产业政策的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: We examine the ways in which political realities shape industrial policy through the lens of modern political economy. We consider two broad “governance constraints”: (1) the political forces that shape how industrial policy is chosen and (2) the ways in which state capacity affects implementation. The framework of modern political economy suggests that government failure is not a necessary feature of industrial policy; rather, it is more likely to fail when countries pursue industrial policies beyond their governance capacity constraints. As such, our political economy of industrial policy is not fatalist. Instead, it enables policymakers to constructively confront challenges.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过现代政治经济学的视角，考察政治现实如何塑造产业政策。我们考虑两大“治理约束”：（1）影响产业政策选择的政治力量，以及（2）国家能力影响实施的方式。现代政治经济学的框架表明，政府失灵并非产业政策的必然特征；相反，当国家追求的产业政策超出其治理能力约束时，更可能失败。因此，我们对产业政策的政治经济学并非宿命论。相反，它使政策制定者能够建设性地应对挑战。

articles.title_cn: 产业政策：造船业的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: Industrial policy has been used throughout history in some form or other by most countries. Yet, it remains one of the most contentious issues among policy makers and economists alike. In part, this is because the empirical evidence on whether and how it should be implemented remains slim. Scant data on government subsidies, conflicting theoretical arguments, and the need to account for governments’ short and long-run objectives, render research particularly challenging. In this article, we outline a theory-based empirical methodology that relies on estimating an industry equilibrium model to measure hidden subsidies, assess their welfare consequences for the domestic and global economy, as well as evaluate the effectiveness of different policy designs. We illustrate this approach using the global shipbuilding industry as a prototypical example of an industry targeted by industrial policy, especially in periods of heavy industrialization. Just in the past century, Europe, followed by Japan, then South Korea, and more recently China, developed national shipbuilding programs to propel their firms to global leaders. Success has been mixed across programs, certainly by welfare metrics, and sometimes even by growth metrics. We use our methodology on China to dissect the impact of such programs, what made them more or less successful, and how we can justify why governments have chosen shipbuilding as a target.
articles.abstract_cn: 产业政策在历史上以某种形式被大多数国家使用过。然而，它仍然是政策制定者和经济学家之间最具争议的问题之一。部分原因在于，关于是否以及如何实施产业政策的实证证据仍然很少。政府补贴数据稀缺、理论论点相互冲突，以及需要考虑政府的短期和长期目标，使得研究特别具有挑战性。在本文中，我们概述了一种基于理论的实证方法，该方法依赖于估计行业均衡模型来衡量隐性补贴，评估其对国内和全球经济的福利后果，以及评估不同政策设计的有效性。我们以全球造船业作为产业政策目标行业的典型例子来说明这种方法，特别是在重工业化时期。仅在过去一个世纪中，欧洲、随后是日本、韩国，以及最近的中国，都制定了国家造船计划以推动其企业成为全球领导者。各计划的效果参差不齐，当然从福利指标来看，有时甚至从增长指标来看也是如此。我们使用我们的方法对中国进行分析，以剖析此类计划的影响、使其或多或少成功的因素，以及我们如何解释政府选择造船业作为目标的原因。

articles.title_cn: 半导体与现代产业政策
articles.abstract_en: Semiconductors have emerged as a headline in the resurgence of modern industrial policy. This paper explores the political economic history of the sector, the changing nature of the semiconductor supply chain, and the new sources of concern that have motivated the most recent turn to government intervention. It also explores details of that turn to industrial policy by the United States, China, Japan, Europe, South Korea, and Taiwan. Modern industrial policy for semiconductors has included not only subsidies for manufacturing, but also new import tariffs, export controls, foreign investment screening, and antitrust actions.
articles.abstract_cn: 半导体已成为现代产业政策复兴中的头条议题。本文探讨了该行业的政治经济历史、半导体供应链的变化性质，以及促使最近转向政府干预的新担忧来源。文章还探讨了美国、中国、日本、欧洲、韩国和台湾地区转向产业政策的细节。现代半导体产业政策不仅包括对制造业的补贴，还包括新的进口关税、出口管制、外国投资审查和反垄断行动。

articles.title_en: Evaluating Behavioral Incentive Compatibility: Insights from Experiments
articles.title_cn: 评估行为激励相容性：来自实验的见解
articles.abstract_en: Incentive compatibility is core to mechanism design. The success of auctions, matching algorithms, and voting systems all hinge on the ability to select incentives that make it in the individual’s interest to reveal their type. But how do we test whether a mechanism that is designed to be incentive compatible is actually so in practice, particularly when faced with boundedly rational agents with nonstandard preferences? We review the many experimental tests that have been designed to assess behavioral incentive compatibility, separating them into two categories: indirect tests that evaluate behavior within the mechanism, and direct tests that assess how participants respond to the mechanism’s incentives. Using belief elicitation as a running example, we show that the most popular elicitations are not behaviorally incentive compatible. In fact, the incentives used under these elicitations discourage rather than encourage truthful revelation.
articles.abstract_cn: 激励相容是机制设计的核心。拍卖、匹配算法和投票系统的成功都依赖于选择激励措施的能力，这些激励措施使得个体有利益去揭示其类型。但当我们面对具有非标准偏好的有限理性代理人时，如何测试一个设计为激励相容的机制在实践中是否确实如此？我们回顾了许多旨在评估行为激励相容性的实验测试，将它们分为两类：间接测试评估机制内的行为，直接测试评估参与者对机制激励的反应。以信念诱导作为贯穿性例子，我们表明最流行的诱导方法在行为上并非激励相容。事实上，这些诱导方法下使用的激励措施阻碍而非鼓励真实揭示。

articles.title_en: Behavioral Incentive Compatibility and Empirically Informed Welfare Analysis: An Introductory Guide
articles.title_cn: 行为激励相容性与经验信息福利分析：入门指南
articles.abstract_en: A growing body of research conducts welfare analysis that assumes behavioral incentive compatibility—that is, that behavior is governed by pursuit of incentives conditional on modeled imperfections in decision-making. In this article, I present several successful examples of studies that apply this approach and I use them to illustrate guidance for pursuing this type of analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的研究进行福利分析时假设行为激励相容性——即行为受追求激励的支配，且以决策中建模的不完美为条件。在本文中，我展示了几个成功应用此方法的研究实例，并利用它们来说明进行此类分析的指导原则。

articles.abstract_en: It matters whether real-world mechanisms are simple. If participants cannot see that a mechanism is incentive-compatible, they may refuse to participate or may behave in ways that undermine the mechanism. There are several ways to formalize what it means for a mechanism to be “simple.” This essay explains three of them, and suggests directions for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 现实世界中的机制是否简单至关重要。如果参与者无法看出某个机制是激励相容的，他们可能会拒绝参与，或者以破坏该机制的方式行事。有几种方法可以形式化“简单”机制的含义。本文阐述了其中三种方法，并为未来研究提出了方向。

articles.title_en: The Problem of Good Conduct among Financial Advisers
articles.title_cn: 金融顾问中的不良行为问题
articles.abstract_en: Households in the United States often rely on financial advisers for investment and savings decisions, yet there is a widespread perception that many advisers are dishonest. This distrust is not unwarranted: approximately one in fifteen advisers has a history of serious misconduct, with this rate rising to one in six in certain regions and firms. We explore the economic foundations of the financial advisory industry and demonstrate how heterogeneity in household financial sophistication and conflicts of interest allow poor financial advice to persist. Using data on the universe of financial advisers and the Survey of Consumer Finances, we document who uses financial advisers and the prevalence of misconduct in the industry. Our findings suggest that a lack of financial sophistication is a key friction, making enhanced disclosure a potentially effective policy response. Supporting this, we show through a difference-in-differences approach that “naming and shaming” firms with high misconduct rates was associated with a 10 percent reduction in misconduct.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国家庭在投资和储蓄决策中常常依赖金融顾问，然而普遍存在一种看法，认为许多顾问不诚实。这种不信任并非没有根据：大约每十五名顾问中就有一名有严重不当行为的历史，在某些地区和公司，这一比例上升到六分之一。我们探讨了金融咨询行业的经济基础，并展示了家庭金融素养的异质性和利益冲突如何使不良金融建议得以持续。利用涵盖所有金融顾问的数据和消费者金融调查，我们记录了谁使用金融顾问以及行业中不当行为的普遍性。我们的研究结果表明，缺乏金融素养是一个关键的摩擦因素，使得加强披露可能成为一种有效的政策回应。支持这一点的是，我们通过双重差分方法表明，对高不当行为率的公司进行“点名批评”与不当行为减少10%相关。

articles.title_cn: 回顾：弗里德曼与施瓦茨，细分解读
articles.abstract_en: What was the contribution of Anna Schwartz to the landmark book she co-authored with Milton Friedman, A Monetary History of the United States, 1867-1960? A close examination of archival evidence suggests three primary contributions Schwartz made to the work, and to Friedman’s career more generally. The first was meeting the classic challenge of quantitative economic history: going into the field to locate and collect archival data that had been assembled for purposes unrelated to economic research, and deciding how best to use that data. Second, Schwartz had a decades-long role as technical sounding board and shaper of the statistical approach taken in the book. Schwartz’s third and arguably greatest contribution was to transform A Monetary History of the United States into a compelling narrative argument that made an impact far beyond the economics profession. Together, these findings show Schwartz to be a scholar who made significant and lasting contributions to monetary economics, economic history, and the broader field of economics.
articles.abstract_cn: 安娜·施瓦茨对与米尔顿·弗里德曼合著的里程碑式著作《美国货币史，1867-1960》有何贡献？对档案证据的仔细考察表明，施瓦茨对该著作以及更广泛地对弗里德曼的职业生涯做出了三项主要贡献。第一项是应对定量经济史中的经典挑战：深入实地，定位并收集那些为与经济研究无关的目的而整理的档案数据，并决定如何最好地利用这些数据。第二，施瓦茨在数十年间担任技术上的参谋，并塑造了该书所采用的统计方法。施瓦茨的第三项贡献，也可以说是最大的贡献，是将《美国货币史》转化为一个引人入胜的叙事性论证，其影响远远超出了经济学界。综合来看，这些发现表明施瓦茨是一位对货币经济学、经济史以及更广泛的经济学领域做出了重大且持久贡献的学者。
